notes: FRONT-DOOR CLEANUP + SHELL FREEZE. The delivered document now identifies as KINGDOM WARS from the first byte: title, apple/application name, description, Open Graph and Twitter card, canonical URL and web manifest all carry the public game name, and a <noscript> fallback states the identity and that JavaScript is required instead of exposing a dead menu. Legacy human-facing labels removed (KWARS1 title branding, Age of Wars, STICK KINGDOM WAR, AGE OF WARS DIAGNOSTICS); internal identifiers that saves and cache eviction depend on are preserved. The legacy hub containers were retired: #hub/#hubpanel are now #shell/#shellpanel with the dead .hubmenu rules deleted, the title screen is a <main> owning the single <h1>, the home menu is a labelled <nav>, decorative glyphs are aria-hidden and icon-only controls have accessible names. Shell architecture Title -> Home -> Mode -> Preparation -> Battle -> Results is now BASELINE/FROZEN. No gameplay, save, or renderer change; save schema remains 3.
